location: Nauvis - Crash Site - Northern Copper Mine
summary: Today was largely about territorial expansion. I completed several rounds of Additional Chunks research and filled in all remaining gaps to shape the base into a clean rectangle, maximizing usable space within the border.

I expanded further west as well. Since most of the western side had already been cleared while mining rocks earlier, the land was immediately usable. The defensive perimeter has been extended accordingly.

Northern copper mining is now underway. I expanded into the deposit, though the space is somewhat tight and I’m not yet satisfied with a permanent layout. It works for now, but it will likely need restructuring.
Log production has been doubled using a temporary setup. It’s not elegant, but it stabilizes wood supply for the time being.

We appear to have reached the upper limit of our current electrical capacity. Power generation is bottlenecked by coal throughput. Without a better power solution, further scaling is effectively capped.
The logical next step is Fluid Pressurization to unlock steam turbines. However, the research cost is enormous — 3,000 science packs.
Even if I manage to automate production at 10 science per minute, that translates to roughly 3,00 minutes — around 5 days. Clearly, we will need far greater scaling to make this realistic.
Tomorrow’s goal is to establish at least some level of science pack automation, but I still need to think carefully about how to break through this scaling wall.

status.resource: Northern copper partially online (temporary layout); log production doubled; coal throughput limiting growth.
status.power: At effective capacity due to coal bottleneck.
status.science: Additional Chunks 6 researched. Fluid Pressurization planned (3k packs required); automation not yet established.
